# Newtown

`Newtown.ttf` is Newtown Regular, a TrueType font by Roger White (1994) in the style of Handel
Gothic, the face of the original's interface fonts. OpenReliant carries it built in, and draws the
menus' and the ITAC's text in it at the window's resolution
([Outline fonts](../../docs/formats/fnt.md#outline-fonts)).

## Source

The file is `Newtown-8e6M.ttf` of `newtown-font.zip` from
[FontSpace](https://www.fontspace.com/newtown-font-f5864), renamed, its SHA-256
`376d82c5b660c059c182d848d0a96da9dbe7277d7c8820f6e9a2c99b1a256c65`. Its name table calls it
version 1.00, made with Type-Designer 3.0.

## Licence

Newtown is in the public domain. Roger White's own site, Roger's Fonts, says that every font on
it is now public domain, for personal and commercial use alike, whatever the readme files that
come with them say, and asks only that the source be acknowledged where a font is used
commercially ([the site as archived on 16 April 2012](https://web.archive.org/web/20120416090521/http://www.rogersfonts.org.uk/)).
The font's own copyright notice and its 1994 readme set the earlier shareware terms that the
site's statement lifts.

OpenReliant acknowledges the source: Newtown, by Roger White, from Roger's Fonts.
